in_sanskrit.name: बृहदरशि
in_sanskrit.meaning: बृहद् (bṛhad) - vast, large, great रशि (rashi) - head
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One with a vast and great head

in_hindi.name: बृहदरशि
in_hindi.meaning: बृहद् (bṛhad) - बड़ा (baḍā) - big रशि (rashi) - सेवन (sevana) - to serve
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who has a big head and serves greatly

in_telugu.name: బృహదరశి
in_telugu.meaning: బృహద్ (bṛhad) - బెది (bedi) - big శి (śi) - శిరః (śiraḥ) - head
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who has a big head

in_marathi.name: Brhadarashi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of vastness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Brhadarashi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Brhadarashi is derived from the Sanskrit term 'Brhadaras', which refers to the 'Lord of vastness'. In Hindu mythology, Brhadarashi is considered to be one of the aspects of Lord Vishnu and is often depicted as a giant, all-encompassing being.
